contract.task_clause:
Hash tables can contribute to an efficient average-case solution for all of the problems described below EXCEPT:
Option A: Counting distinct values: Given a set of n keys, determine the number of distinct key values.
Option B: Dynamic dictionary: Support the operations of insert, delete, and search in a dictionary.
Option C: Range search: Given values a and b, find all the records whose key value is in the range a, b.
Option D: Symbol table lookup: Given a program identifier, find its type and address.
